# TRexR

An R package implementation of the Irish Lab’s T-Rex algorithm.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`TREX()`](https://davidrach.github.io/TRexR/reference/TREX.md) : This
  does this
- [`TREX_cluster()`](https://davidrach.github.io/TRexR/reference/TREX_cluster.md)
  : This does this
- [`TREX_cluster_plot()`](https://davidrach.github.io/TRexR/reference/TREX_cluster_plot.md)
  : This does this
- [`TREX_cluster_results()`](https://davidrach.github.io/TRexR/reference/TREX_cluster_results.md)
  : This does this
- [`TREX_counts()`](https://davidrach.github.io/TRexR/reference/TREX_counts.md)
  : This does this

  : This does this

  : This does this

## Authors

Sierra Barone Lima is the creator of the T-REX analysis pipeline, and
original author of the code.

Jonathan Irish conceptualized the pipeline with Sierra, oversaw project
development, and contributed to the original code.

Cass Mayeda refactored the pipeline, integrated contributions from
Claire Cross and Hannah Thirman, and made minor useability improvements.

Claire Cross developed a new method for binning that made T-REX analysis
identical in the case the file order is switched.

Hannah Thirman contributed code to color the plot titles blue and red to
match the identified populations.

David Rach modified the original GitHub repository contents into an R
package, and made minor adjustments to allow the vignettes to
reproducibly build.

Updated 11/9/2026
